text: かくとうかも　さいきんは　おしゃれに　なったよな…

structure.jp: おしゃれに　なったよな…

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: おしゃれに　なった
patterns.explanation: に plus なる says something turns into that state. おしゃれに　なった = 'have become stylish'.

patterns.name: 〜よな
patterns.explanation: よな at the end is a casual way of saying something half to yourself and expecting agreement. なったよな = 'they've become so, haven't they'.
